rows.grounds: optative verb expressing prohibition with na

items.question: Can renewed prohibited contact occur without causing another ritual reversal?
premises: Contact must never be made at any time.
Renewed contact results in reversal again.
items.inference: Therefore any contact must be strictly avoided to prevent repeated reversal.
uncertainties: The exact object that must not be touched is implied from preceding verses.
The precise grammatical analysis of spṛśetaṃ and spṛṣṭhe is uncertain.
items.plain_english: One should never touch them at any time; but if they are touched, the reversal occurs again.
